## What's new

- PICO-8, with your own copy: put its Raspberry Pi download in the card's PICO-8 folder (ChaOS Transfer has a place for it) and a PICO-8 shelf appears, Splore first. Your own carts go in Roms/PICO-8.
- Syncthing keeps your saves, games and BIOS the same on your other devices: MENU > ROM Management > Syncthing. Pair from the Brick; nothing runs while you play.
- ROM Management, a new page in the menu, holds RomM and Syncthing.
- ChaOS Transfer opens folders with thousands of games, and covers load faster while you scroll (from TortOS 2.2.1).
- A menu's scroll arrow no longer sits on top of its hint line.

---

ChaOS 2.2.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v2.2.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v2.2.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
